contract_dependency_note: Registry IDs are canonical planning labels only. They identify prerequisite areas and do not constitute approved APIs, schemas, or evidence that a contract exists.

cases.title: Open a supported project
cases.scenario: Open a valid fixture whose project-format version is declared supported by the selected Studio or Runtime.
cases.expected_behavior: Opening succeeds and reports the exact project/product compatibility tuple.

cases.title: Reject malformed projects
cases.scenario: Open malformed input or a project missing a contract-required field.
cases.expected_behavior: Fail closed with an actionable diagnostic; the source project is not overwritten.

cases.title: Reject unknown major versions
cases.scenario: Open a project with an unknown project-format major version.
cases.expected_behavior: Do not guess, coerce, or discard fields; report unsupported format/version.

cases.title: Round-trip supported projects
cases.scenario: Save and reopen each supported fixture without semantic edits.
cases.expected_behavior: Stable IDs, references, properties, and required data retain contract-defined meaning.

cases.title: Preserve unsupported optional features
cases.scenario: Open a project containing an unsupported optional feature.
cases.expected_behavior: Apply the approved preservation/diagnostic policy; never silently remove data.

cases.title: Block unknown required capabilities
cases.scenario: Validate a project that requires a capability unknown to the selected target.
cases.expected_behavior: Block build/export and identify the unsupported requirement.

cases.title: Align UUID schema and semantic validation
cases.scenario: Validate UUIDv4 boundary values and entity identifiers across every schema and semantic validator used by a supported project format, including uppercase/lowercase variants where the schema permits them.
cases.expected_behavior: The schema and semantic validator implement the same approved UUID canonicalization policy. Case variants cannot bypass project-wide stable-ID uniqueness, and accepted fixtures round-trip without identifier rewriting.

cases.title: Resolve and preserve the application icon asset reference
cases.scenario: Validate a project whose window references an application-icon asset, then inspect the exported Windows package; include missing references, wrong asset kinds, invalid ICO headers, and truncated declared image payloads.
cases.expected_behavior: The accepted project contract requires the window icon reference to resolve to an allowed application-icon asset. Invalid references or out-of-range ICO payloads fail closed before packaging, and the packaged resource bytes and reported digest match the validated source asset.
evidence_required: source and packaged resource SHA-256 comparison

cases.title: Migrate every supported source version
cases.scenario: Migrate fixtures from every declared source format version to the selected target version.
cases.expected_behavior: An approved deterministic migration path exists and output validates against the target format.

cases.title: Preserve project semantics during migration
cases.scenario: Migrate a fixture containing assets, stable IDs, bindings, actions, and optional fields.
cases.expected_behavior: Supported semantic values/references remain correct; unsupported values receive explicit diagnostics.

cases.title: Preserve source after migration failure
cases.scenario: Force a migration failure after an intermediate transformation.
cases.expected_behavior: Original source remains recoverable and no partial output is reported as successful.

cases.title: Make current-format migration a no-op
cases.scenario: Run migration assessment on an already-current project.
cases.expected_behavior: No repeated destructive transformation occurs; tool reports migration is unnecessary.

cases.title: Reject missing migration paths
cases.scenario: Attempt migration from a source version with no approved path.
cases.expected_behavior: Stop with source preserved and identify the unsupported version/path.

cases.title: Diagnose invalid references during migration
cases.scenario: Migrate a project with missing or invalid asset references.
cases.expected_behavior: Preserve source data and report each invalid reference under the approved migration policy.

cases.title: Compare project requirements to target capabilities
cases.scenario: Compare a project's required capability set with the selected renderer's declared capabilities.
cases.expected_behavior: Produce a deterministic supported/unsupported report.

cases.title: Block absent required capabilities
cases.scenario: Select a target missing a required component or capability.
cases.expected_behavior: Block build/export before packaging and identify the exact requirement.

cases.title: Fail closed on unknown capability versions
cases.scenario: Validate a project that requires an unknown capability identifier/version.
cases.expected_behavior: Fail closed unless the approved compatibility policy explicitly classifies it as optional.

cases.title: Detect capability regressions
cases.scenario: Compare capability declarations across two target renderer versions.
cases.expected_behavior: Report removed/changed capabilities and execute affected regression fixtures.

cases.title: Verify shared capability semantics
cases.scenario: Have two target renderers claim the same capability contract.
cases.expected_behavior: Both pass the shared behavior fixtures before capability is treated as portable.

cases.title: Match shared visual fixtures
cases.scenario: Render the same supported visual fixture in Studio preview and exported Launcher.
cases.expected_behavior: Geometry, visible content, states, and interactions match within approved tolerances.

cases.title: Match interaction outcomes
cases.scenario: Exercise supported interactions/actions with deterministic test data in preview and export.
cases.expected_behavior: Event results and observable state changes match across preview and Runtime.

cases.title: Match failure-state behavior
cases.scenario: Use missing assets, offline data, malformed content, and action-failure fixtures.
cases.expected_behavior: Both surfaces produce contract-defined fallback states and diagnostic behavior.

cases.title: Match layout across size and DPI
cases.scenario: Resize the supported preview/export window sizes and DPI/scaling configurations.
cases.expected_behavior: Both surfaces follow the approved layout and scaling rules.

cases.title: Match accessibility and localization behavior
cases.scenario: Run keyboard, focus, Unicode, and supported RTL fixtures across preview and export.
cases.expected_behavior: Both surfaces meet the accessibility/localization contract for the declared feature set.

cases.title: Reject malformed or oversized imports
cases.scenario: Import malformed, oversized, or structurally invalid project input.
cases.expected_behavior: Reject safely with bounded resource use and actionable diagnostics.

cases.title: Block asset path escape
cases.scenario: Import an asset reference escaping the authorized project asset root.
cases.expected_behavior: Reject under the approved path policy; no outside file is read or modified.

cases.title: Block prohibited credentials in exports
cases.scenario: Scan project/export artifacts containing prohibited credentials.
cases.expected_behavior: Export gate blocks and reports a sanitized finding without echoing the secret.

cases.title: Deny actions outside the allowlist
cases.scenario: Exercise an action absent from the approved action registry/allowlist.
cases.expected_behavior: Deny the action; no arbitrary process, shell, or filesystem behavior occurs.

cases.title: Redact diagnostic output
cases.scenario: Generate diagnostics from a credential-bearing failure fixture.
cases.expected_behavior: Logs and diagnostic bundles redact secrets and private values under the approved policy.

cases.title: Install on a clean supported environment
cases.scenario: Install the declared package on a clean environment matching the target baseline.
cases.expected_behavior: Installation succeeds with only documented prerequisites.

cases.title: Upgrade from supported prior releases
cases.scenario: Upgrade from each declared supported previous package version.
cases.expected_behavior: User projects/configuration are preserved under the migration and release contracts.

cases.title: Verify release artifact metadata
cases.scenario: Verify an exported artifact against its release inventory and trust policy.
cases.expected_behavior: Integrity/signing status is accurately reported; unsigned artifacts are not represented as trusted.

cases.title: Recover from interrupted app updates
cases.scenario: Interrupt or fail an application update at each documented update stage.
cases.expected_behavior: Previous working version remains usable or documented recovery succeeds.

cases.title: Verify uninstall and reinstall behavior
cases.scenario: Uninstall and reinstall the package on a supported environment.
cases.expected_behavior: Cleanup and user-data retention match the documented package policy.

cases.title: Measure project open and validation
cases.scenario: Open and validate the agreed representative project.
cases.expected_behavior: Measurements are reproducible and compared with approved thresholds.

cases.title: Measure preview and Runtime rendering
cases.scenario: Render the representative project in preview and exported Launcher.
cases.expected_behavior: Startup, idle resource use, memory, and render behavior are recorded for the exact target tuple.

cases.title: Detect repeated-workflow regressions
cases.scenario: Run the agreed repeated authoring/launcher workflow against a retained baseline.
cases.expected_behavior: Regressions are detected using comparable environment and fixture identities.

cases.title: Reproduce conformance from a clean checkout
cases.scenario: Run the complete applicable conformance set from a clean checkout/environment.
cases.expected_behavior: Results are reproducible and toolchain/fixture versions are recorded.
